content.short: An utility metaverse platform serving as a 3D-VR-AR UI for Cardano operating system, community, ecosystem. It's not a game!
content.description:
Metaloverse is a new Art-Tech Metaverse / Web3 concept that offers the Cardano community a place to call "home" and new original ways to interact and promote the truly valuable things in the Cardano ecosystem. We are building Metaloverse as a utility metaverse platform serving as a 3D-VR-AR UI for Cardano operating system, community and ecosystem.

It's not a game!

It is designed as a virtual world that runs 3D-VR-AR directly on desktop and mobile browsers using three.js / webGL and webGPU technology, thus eliminating the need to install additional applications. The Metaloverse map has 21.000 hexagons, called the "Space-Cells". These space-cells represent pieces of space in our world and there will always be only 21000. They will be populated with the best projects and with those community members who bring value to all Cardano users. In order to use the space in the Metaloverse to its maximum, including all the features, you will need something that in the real world could be considered a building, a house, a villa, an apartment or a shop. But we, as creators of this new universe, thought of something completely original - the Metaobject.

The metaobject is based on a 3D NFT, with a futuristic design that has two important functions:

The metaobject is called so, because it is at the same time an NFT on the Cardano network but at the same time a real object, made of metal on high-precision CNC machines, the same machines that produce high-end luxury watches. Physical metaobjects are the mirror of 3D NFTs, and we see them as "the soul and body" and they are very complex being made of many metal parts that join together with great precision like a LEGO game. We will encourage owners to disassemble them down into their smallest pieces and rebuild them as many times as they want, to create an even greater mental connection with that object and with the Cardano network at the same time.

The metaobject will always be with you. You can practically hold the NFT in the palm of your hand and with the help of augmented reality you can see and show your friends the same hologram that you see on your desktop or mobile screen. The basis of the entire economy will be the $METALO token, whose supply is 21 million and which will be distributed for free to the members of the Metaloverse and Cardano community.

In Metaloverse you will be able to make exchanges, sales, rent your properties, you will be able to socialize, get to know new people and what they are doing. Through the internal chat system, you will be able to promote your business or NFT art. Because it is native 3D, the platform will easily be able to host galleries for 3D, VR and AR NFTs. You can also use Metaloverse as a search engine on the Cardano network and not only.

Metaloverse is the place where the community, NFT artists, developers and infrastructure elements are brought together in one place and presented in a completely original way.
